units.summary: New test evicts a series via CompactSelectedSeries, forces WAL checkpoints, and asserts the evicted series' record remains in the checkpoint because walExpiry is still in effect.
units.headline: New test: evicted selected-series record kept in WAL checkpoint
units.reason: New test only; no production behavior change.

units.summary: Generalizes stale-series truncation to take a shouldEvict predicate and return the evicted count. The early-return guard changes from MinTime >= maxt to MinTime > maxt, so a single-timestamp head is now processed. This also affects the stale-series path.
units.headline: truncateSeries takes eviction predicate; guard now inclusive of MinTime==maxt
units.reason: Eviction logic and the boundary condition changed on a shared path, which can affect which series are removed and the WAL tombstones written.
focus: MinTime > maxt change also applies to the stale-series path; confirm that is safe
WaitForPendingReadersInTimeRange with MinTime==maxt
tombstones are written only for series actually deleted

units.summary: Renamed from gcStaleSeries and now takes a predicate. The stale-series gauge is decremented by the number of deleted series that were actually stale, rather than all deleted ones.
units.headline: gcSeries decrements numStaleSeries only for actually stale deleted series
units.reason: Changes head metrics and counter accounting during series eviction.
focus: numStaleSeries is decremented by the stale-deleted count, not seriesRemoved
the stale check at deletion matches how numStaleSeries was incremented

units.summary: The stale check is replaced with a caller-supplied shouldEvict predicate. The function now also counts deleted series that are stale and returns that count as an extra value.
units.headline: stripeSeries.gcSeries uses shouldEvict predicate and counts stale deletions
units.reason: Core series deletion condition is parameterized; wrong predicate use could evict live series.
focus: shouldEvict is called under the series lock
isStaleSeries is evaluated on the same state as the predicate
stale series are counted only once
